name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1803: A push to main PUBLISHES, so the gate that matters stands in front of the deploy and not in front of the push. publish.yml runs the smoke set (read from hooks/pre-push, never restated, so the two cannot drift), the python suites, and a review of the bytes that actually landed - and publication is held if the review returns a HIGH finding. The local deploy stays in the hook until CI has deployed once: removing a working publisher before the new one is proven leaves two halves and no publication.
